# Pre-Meeting Briefing: Infosys, 17 November 2026

**Window covered:** 18 October to 17 November 2026
**Sources:** Search results provided only. Items are listed by date.

## Summary
Infosys's Q2 FY27 results (23 October) disappointed the market. Revenue grew 1.3% year over year, and management lowered annual revenue growth guidance. Shares fell sharply afterward. Since then, the company has announced expansion in Hyderabad and Bengaluru-area capacity, and it has signaled investor outreach in the UK.

## What changed

**Results and guidance**
- Q2 revenue was $5,145M, up 1.3% YoY (1.5% in constant currency). AI revenue grew 29% sequentially and reached 10.5% of revenue. Operating margin was 21.0%. Large-deal TCV was $5.2B, 62% of it net new, including one deal above $2B. (https://www.stocktitan.net/news/INFY/infosys-differentiated-ai-strategy-and-a-sharp-focus-on-value-unlock-sjalje8xfokm.html)
- Infosys lowered its annual revenue growth guidance. The ADR fell over 7%, and the NSE share price closed at ₹1,153.8 on the prior Friday. (https://upstox.com/news/market-news/stocks/infosys-adr-falls-over-7-as-it-major-lowers-annual-revenue-growth-guidance-everything-investors-need-to-know/article-202325)
- Infosys reported a North America revenue decline amid sector slowdowns. (https://www.scanx.trade/stock-market-news/companies/infosys-hold-investor-roadshows-london-edinburgh-november/54668108) *(headline only; full article not in results)*
- Shares fell 6.5% after Q2 EPS missed estimates by $0.01. (https://www.scanx.trade/stock-market-news/companies/infosys-hold-investor-roadshows-london-edinburgh-november/54668108) *(headline only)*
- BMO Capital raised its price target to $13 and maintained Market Perform. (https://www.scanx.trade/stock-market-news/companies/infosys-hold-investor-roadshows-london-edinburgh-november/54668108) *(headline only)*

**Markets**
- A block trade of ₹69.49 crore was executed on the NSE on 23 October. (https://www.scanx.trade/stock-market-news/companies/infosys-hold-investor-roadshows-london-edinburgh-november/54668108) *(headline only)*
- Shares slid over 2% on 2 November, and the Hyderabad campus expansion did not lift sentiment. (https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/markets/stock-markets/infosys-shares-slide-over-2-hyderabad-campus-expansion-fails-to-lift-sentiment/article71655856.ece)

**Hires and capacity**
- Infosys expanded its Truist GCC in India and onboarded 1,000 colleagues. (https://www.scanx.trade/stock-market-news/companies/infosys-hold-investor-roadshows-london-edinburgh-november/54668108) *(headline only)*
- Infosys opened a new 1.1M sq ft block at its Pocharam campus in Hyderabad to serve emerging technologies. (https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/city/hyderabad/infosys-sets-up-new-1-1m-sq-ft-block-at-pocharam-campus-in-hyderabad-to-cater-to-emerging-technologies/articleshow/135366954.cms)
- At the Hyderabad campus inauguration, Infosys said it serves banking, retail, life sciences and manufacturing clients. It employs over 325,000 people across 59 countries. (https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/markets/stock-markets/infosys-shares-slide-over-2-hyderabad-campus-expansion-fails-to-lift-sentiment/article71655856.ece)

**Investor relations and events**
- Management will attend non-deal investor roadshows in London and Edinburgh in November. Exact dates were cut off in the results. (https://www.scanx.trade/stock-market-news/companies/infosys-hold-investor-roadshows-london-edinburgh-november/54668108)
- The Infosys Prize 2026 winners were announced on 12 November in Bengaluru. This is a foundation award, not a commercial event. (https://news.careers360.com/infosys-prize-2026-scholars-from-tifr-princeton-carnegie-mellon-uc-san-ranscisco-new-south-wales-singapore-universities-winners)

**Launches:** No product or service launches were found in the results.

## Gaps
- Full texts exist only for the Hyderabad, Pocharam, Q2 results and ADR articles. Other items are headlines.
- The company profile page is undated and was not used for recent changes. (https://tavily.com/knowledge/company/Gbd7vUUlzCYP)

## Open questions
1. **Guidance:** What drove the cut to annual revenue growth guidance, and how much of the North America decline is sector-wide versus Infosys-specific? What does the Q3 outlook assume?
2. **Deals and AI:** Of the $5.2B large-deal TCV (62% net new), how much will convert to revenue, and on what timeline? What is the path for AI revenue beyond 10.5% of total?
3. **Capacity and roadshows:** Is the new Hyderabad and Pocharam capacity ahead of demand, and how does hiring (such as the 1,000 Truist GCC onboardings) fit a slower growth outlook? What investor messages will management take to London and Edinburgh, and on what dates?
